38. I have heard the submissions of the ld. counsel for the plaintiff and I have perused the record.
39. The ex parte evidence led by the plaintiff is unrebutted and unchallenged.
The testimony of PW-1 who has deposed along the lines of the plaint is unrebutted and unchallenged.
The defendants are operating from a common market.
As per the reports of the local commissioners, the shopkeepers at the concerned market place at Karol Bagh harassed the local commissioners and did not permit them to execute the commission.
The local commissioners have reported that they were abused and there was no cooperation from the defendants.

The local commissioners have reported that the shutters of the shops were closed and since there was threat of physical assaults upon the local commissioners, they had to retreat without executing the commission.

Some of the local commissioners (Mr. K.V. Girhish Chowdhary, Mr. Chetan Kumar Giri) have reported that they could spot garments bearing the trademark 'Tommy' and 'Tommy Hilfiger' in the concerned premises of some of the defendants.
It appears that the defendants have adopted the strategy of avoiding the suit proceedings.
The defendants stopped appearing after filing of the written statement.
It also appears that the defendants along with other shopkeepers in the market physically prevented the local commissioners from executing the commission for seizing the goods.

In this manner, the defendants have prevented seizure of infringing goods while at CS (COMM) NO.382 OF 2019 M/s Tommy Hilfiger Europe B.V VS Amarjeet Singh & ors. page no.20 the same time conveniently avoiding the present proceedings.

rpc_texts: The plaintiff would be entitled to relief of permanent injunction as prayed for in the plaint.
The defendants would be liable for penal damages.
The local commissioners could not make the seizures as they were physically prevented from doing so.
I would hold that each defendant would be separately liable for punitive damages of Rs. 1,50,000/- each.
40. Accordingly, the issues are decided in favour of the plaintiff and against the defendants.

The present suit is decreed in favour of the plaintiff and against the defendants in terms of the prayer clauses (a), (b), (c) and (d) of the plaint and also for damages of Rs.1,50,000/- each to be paid by each defendant CS (COMM) NO.382 OF 2019 M/s Tommy Hilfiger Europe B.V VS Amarjeet Singh & ors. page no.21 separately along with interest @ 10% p.a. from the date of the decree till actual realisation.
41. Costs are awarded in favour of the plaintiff.
The costs shall include the expenses incurred in the fees of the local commissioners.
Pleader's fee is calculated as Rs. 25,000/-.
Let the decree-sheet be drawn up accordingly.
